date_note: Day MEXT published its notice; it says access was detected on Oct 1, 2026.
title: MEXT says unauthorized access to its procurement system may have leaked a maximum of 163,953 business records
org: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
summary: MEXT's notice says a third party accessed servers of its government procurement information system, detected on Oct 1. Data possibly leaked is a maximum of 163,953 entries of business operators' company and representative names and a maximum of 1,778 email addresses. MEXT says no public release or misuse has been confirmed and it has reported to the Personal Information Protection Commission.
plain: Japan's education ministry says its procurement system was accessed without authorization and a maximum of 163,953 business records and a maximum of 1,778 email addresses may have leaked. No misuse has been confirmed.
exec: Company names, representatives and emails of suppliers to the government may have leaked, MEXT's notice says.

validation.note: MEXT's own notice read; Cybersecurity.com (Japan) relays it.
